name: Vinculum Hearts ~Iris Mahou Gakuen~
original_name: Vinculum Hearts ～アイリス魔法学園～
source:
The Iris School of Wizardry, nicknamed ISW.
A school where girls and boys blessed with intelligence, talent, and economic fortune gather.

The difficulty factor is said to be more than 300, but those who graduate are promised a sparkling future as elite members of every important institution in the country.

The protagonist' Aria's parents died when she was a child, she spent her days taking care of her parents old rare bookshop and wishing she could someday become a fine magician like her father was. Then one day a letter came to her. 
It was permission to enroll into ISW.

[Translated from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.operahouse.isw]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
Iris魔法学园，简称ISW，是一所汇聚智慧、才能与财富兼备男女学生的学校。

据说入学难度超过300，但毕业生能作为各国重要机构精英，拥有闪耀未来。

主人公阿莉娅自幼父母双亡，照料父母留下的珍贵旧书店，梦想有朝一日成为像父亲一样优秀的魔法师。某天，她收到一封信：获准入学ISW。

[译自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.operahouse.isw]Google Play[/url]]
